annotation.title_clean: Action plan for the digital transformation of Slovakia for 2019 – 2022
annotation.title_en: Action plan for the digital transformation of Slovakia for 2019 – 2022
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Deputy Prime Minister of the Slovak Republic for Investments and Informatization (ODPMII)
annotation.summary_en: Slovakia's 2019–2022 action plan implementing its 2030 Digital Transformation Strategy. It sets measures on digital skills, data economy, smart mobility, FinTech, public administration innovation and AI support, using regulatory sandboxes, dynamic regulation and EU funding. Physical robotics appears only marginally (school robotics, autonomous mobility).
key_provisions_or_claims: Four strategic areas: education and digital skills, data and digital economy, public administration, AI development
Establish AI research and utilisation platform, HPC and cybersecurity competence centres, and Digital Innovation Hubs
Introduce dynamic regulation and regulatory sandboxes for fast-developing sectors
Review possibilities and problems for regulating AI; adopt binding rules reflecting moral principles
Monitoring by ODPMII Directorate General for Digital Agenda with annual reports to government
